# Fetch ALL following artists with pagination
following=set()
page_limit=20
i=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token,page_index=i,page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        raise RuntimeError(resp['message'])
    print('following page', i, 'count', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    for a in resp:
        following.add(a['artist_id'])
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    i+=1
print('total following artists', len(following), 'ids', sorted(following))

classical_song_ids=[82,139,151,152,216,266,267]
# Collect artists from these songs
classical_artists=set()
classical_song_artist_map={}
for sid in classical_song_ids:
    sg=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=sg.get('genre')
    print('song', sid, 'title', sg.get('title'), 'genre', genre, 'artists', [(a['id'],a['name']) for a in sg.get('artists',[])])
    artists=[a['id'] for a in sg.get('artists',[])]
    classical_song_artist_map[sid]=artists
    for aid in artists:
        classical_artists.add(aid)
print('unique classical artists', len(classical_artists), 'ids', sorted(classical_artists))

to_follow=sorted(classical_artists - following)
print('artists to follow', len(to_follow), 'ids', to_follow)

# Follow artists not already followed
follow_results=[]
for aid in to_follow:
    r=apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
    follow_results.append((aid,r))
    print('follow_artist', aid, 'resp', r)

print('done, followed count', len(to_follow))
